tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// jo bo shākya mu ni la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /grangs med gong nas 'og min nyams dga' bar// gtsang ma'i gnas bzhugs yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// mtha' yas tshogs mnga' mthar phyin mdzad pa gang*// bcom ldan dbang po'i tog la gus phyag 'tshal// chos kyi sku las khyod nyid ma g.yos kyang*/ /dpa' bo chen pos 'gro rnams smin mdzad phyir| |da dung slar yang lha yi bla ma mdzad// bcom ldan dam pa tog la gus phyag 'tshal// 'dzam gling 'di na gzigs pa lngas 'khrungs te// lha rnams bag med spong zhing 'dus byas chos// dga' bde bsam pas 'byung 'di sngon 'bras zhes// bcom ldan lha yi bla la gus phyag 'tshal// dregs dang so so'i phyogs lhung bskyungs nas su| |lhun sdug glang chen mchog gyur drug ldan zhig /sgyu 'phrul gso sbyong gnas pa'i glo g.yas zhugs// bcom ldan theg chen glang por gus phyag 'tshal// zla bcu rdzogs nas lumbi'i tshal chen du// gnod med go bar phyes nas skye sbyangs gsung*// phyogs bcur bgrod cing shis brjod lhas kyang bstod// bcom ldan sprul sku mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// rig gnas sgyu rtsal sna lnga'i pha mthar son| |zhabs mtheb glang chen rgyang bsrings lha mis bstod// ser skya'i gnas na 'dren pa su zhig kye// bcom ldan shākya'i tog la gus phyag 'tshal| |dril bu'i sgra yi bu mo grags 'dzin ma// sa 'tsho ma dang ri dwags skyes la sogs// drug khri btsun mo'i 'khor dang dga' mgur spyod// bcom ldan mnga' bdag rje la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sngon gyi smon lam sil snyan sgra yis bskul/ /sgo bzhir skyo tshul bstan nas mkha' lam gshegs// rnam dag drung du nyid las rab tu byung*// bcom ldan nges par 'byung la gus phyag 'tshal// sred chags dga' bde mi gtsang dri bzhin spangs// nai rañdzānar lo drug smyung bar bzhugs// dka' ba spyad nas brtson pa mthar phyin mdzad// bcom ldan drang srong che la gus phyag 'tshal// phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis// dka' thub spongs zhes rdo rje gdan la bskul// legs skyes 'o thug phul nas smon bzang btab// bcom ldan gtso ma'i skur gyur gus phyag 'tshal// rdo rje'i gdan la dam bcas mnyam par bzhag

/bdud 'dul thugs rje'i 'od zer kun tu bkye// dga' rab dbang phyug dpung bcas sde rnams brtul// bcom ldan g.yul las rgyal la gus phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas byang chub rim pa gsum brnyais tshe// bdun phrag gcig tu ci yang mi gsung bar// 'dzam gling stong gsum byang chub snying la gzigs// btang bzung nas byon kun tu rgyu rnams brtul// bcom ldan bgrod gyur shis brjod gus phyag 'tshal// tshangs pas rtsibs stong ldan pa phul nas bskul// wā rā ṇa sīr bden bzhi'i chos rnams gsungs// lnga sde la sogs brgyad khris bden pa mthong*// bcom ldan bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor la bstod// bya rgod phung rir dgra bcom drug cu dang*// mchog dang bzang po dge slong dge bsnyen sogs// lha klu sna tshogs grangs med 'dus pa la// bcom ldan mtshan nyid med par ston la bstod// rtsa mchog drung dang lha klu'i gnas rnams su// ma 'dres chos kyis ma smin gang yang med// chos 'khor gsum gyi brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs| |bcom ldan nges don 'khor lo bskor la bstod// sku dngos 'dul bya rdzogs pa de dgongs nas// rtswa can yul gyi sā la'i shing drung du// sprul pa'i sku de'i sgyu ma'i snang brnyan bsdus// bcom ldan mi rtag rgyu 'bras ston la bstod// mtha' yas phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dang*// byang sems slob ma lha dang drang srong bcas| |mdzad tshul ji tsam bskal brgyar brjod 'das kyang*// bcom ldan mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdo tsam bstod// rgya mtsho'i nang nas skra rtses blang ba bzhin// sgo gsum gus pas bstod tshig bgyis pa'i 'bras// ma gyur 'gro dang bdag sogs mos ldan rnams// bcom ldan mtshan dpe myur du 'grub par shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas gtso ma'i mdog can lha dang mi yi dbugs 'byin 'gran zla med pa'i sku brnyan dam pa'i drung*// lha rdzas reg na bde zhing yid 'phrog srab 'jam yang la dri ma med pa dkar ba'i mdang ldan mchog 'di dag

/mos gdung drag po'i sor bcu snying gar sbyar nas 'jig rten gsum mgon mchog la phul ba'i mthu dang ngag gi nus pa yis/ /rin chen bstan dang bstan 'dzin mdzad phrin mthar khyab srid 'dir rdzogs ldan dus bzhin dga' bde spyad mthar sangs rgyas shog /ces pa sprel lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gcig gi snga char dpal gung ri dkar po zhes bya ba sde srid kyi pho brang nas/ 'bri gung pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog ming gis ra sa 'phrul snang gi jo bo rin po che'i snyan dar la bris te phul ba dge/ //maṅga laṃ//
